structured_output.what_is_happening: A token named after the looksmaxxing streamer Clavicular (Braden Peters) was created about 14 minutes ago directly as a PumpSwap pool. It did not come through the pump.fun bonding curve, and the deploy platform is unknown. It has pumped about 190% to roughly $53k market cap on $264k of volume, with about 1,039 unique buyers but only 121 unique sellers. Clavicular is in the news right now: CNN and CBS covered his rape charge on 2026-09-22. At least 10 older Clavicular/CLAV tokens exist, and all of them are dead.
